Shinji Kanda’sUntamed Lines

Shinji Kanda brings raw underground comic energy to the Pokémon world through aggressive ink cross-hatching, gritty textures, and psychedelic linework. His cards radiate a frantic, electrifying intensity unlike anything else in the hobby.
